_note: Single source of truth for how each sign size nests on the Mimaki bed. make-jig.ps1 and make-imposition.ps1 both read this file, so the printed jig outlines and the artwork imposed onto them cannot disagree. Change a layout HERE, never in one script.

bed._note: Printable area, not the table. Confirmed against the machine, not the brochure.

large._note: Proven layout - three Large signs printed on acrylic and passed visual inspection. 3*125 + 2*12.5 + 2*10 = 420, an exact bed fit. Only 20 mm spare across the width, so X margin is forced.

medium._note: 3*120 + 2*20 + 2*10 = 420, also an exact fit, and POS 2 lands on the exact bed centre. Two across will not fit: 2*450 = 900 > 610.

small._note: 8-up, 2 across x 4 down, an exact fit both ways: 2*290 + 15 + 2*7.5 = 610, and 4*85 + 2*16 + 3*16 = 420. Corroborated by the real 8-up production PSD, which nests blanks at X 8.6/313.9 and Y 11.3/107.6/206.3/303.3 mm - within ~2 mm of this grid. That original was hand-nested and its row pitch varies (96.3/98.7/97.0); a regular grid is used here instead so the jig and the imposition can share one rule. Both gaps clear the mandatory 4 mm bleed with room to spare.
